name: ClockShark
description_en:
ClockShark is a product in the Time tracking category. Its directory profile covers Timesheet Management, Overtime Calculation, Offline Time Tracking, Multiple Billing Rates, Mobile Time Tracking, Billable & Non-billable Hours, Automatic Time Capture, Employee Database.

Additional listed capabilities include Leave Tracking (Vacation), Billing and Invoicing. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $8.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: collect and review time records; store structured information about employees; prepare invoices and track billing records. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
ClockShark 属于工时管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括工时表管理、加班计算、离线工时跟踪、多种计费费率、移动端工时跟踪、可计费与不可计费工时、自动工时记录、员工资料库。

资料还列出休假跟踪、账单与开票。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $8.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：汇集并审核工时记录；集中保存结构化员工资料；制作发票并跟踪账单记录。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
